summary: The root وَدْقٌ (wdq) refers to rain, which can be either gentle or violent. Some sources specifically define it as violent rain.
lane: وَدْقٌ ذ Rain, (S, K, TA,) whether violent or gentle: (TA:) or violent rain. (MF in art. قهب .)

headwords.def: Rain, (S, K, TA,) whether violent or gentle: (TA:) or violent rain. (MF in art. قهب.)
: occurring in the TA, art. قهب; from الوَدْقُ, meaning Violent rain. (MF.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
